description: One-shot deep research. Runs the full pipeline in a single call: shortlist (semantic + structured match), a structural dossier with due-diligence signals per supplier, an AI-synthesized comparison grounded strictly in that data, and a recommended next step. Returns the complete result (non-streaming) — use this when your agent cannot consume the /mcp/deep SSE stream. Results are cached for 24h on identical brief + filters, so repeated calls are cheap and citations are stable. Requires a partner or enterprise key.
